# Readers choose a page size through the per_page URL parameter, capped at 50.
require "pagy/extras/items"
# A page past the end, such as a stale bookmark, shows the last page instead of failing.
require "pagy/extras/overflow"

Pagy::DEFAULT[:items] = 10
Pagy::DEFAULT[:items_param] = :per_page
Pagy::DEFAULT[:max_items] = 50
Pagy::DEFAULT[:overflow] = :last_page
  owner is its notebook's owner, so `User#notes` (through notebooks) is the
  authorized note scope. There is no separate `user_id` on notes.
- `NotesController#index` serves `/notes` and its `/journal` alias. It lists the
  reader's notes newest first with an ID tie-breaker, and supports title search
  and notebook and status filters. `show` renders one note's rich body.
- Pagy 8.6.3 paginates that filtered list after ordering, 10 notes per page by
  default. The search form offers 5, 10, 25, or 50 as the `per_page` URL
  parameter. Larger requested sizes are capped at 50. Next and previous links keep
  the filters and page size. A blank, zero, negative, or nonnumeric page shows the
  first page, and a page past the end shows the last page. The form never sends
  an invalid size. A blank, zero, negative, or nonnumeric `per_page` in a URL is
  not handled, and Pagy raises `Pagy::VariableError`.
- A note's body is Action Text (`has_rich_text :body`), edited with Trix.
  Attachments are Active Storage blobs on the local Disk service. `Note` rejects
  saves that embed a blob over 1 MB. Direct uploads store blobs before this
Start from the authorized relation. Apply filters and ordering before pagination.
Use a deterministic secondary order when ties affect page membership.
Preload the associations the [view](views.md) actually reads. Avoid turning a
relation into an array early just to filter or sort in Ruby.

Fizzy's [board controller](../references/fizzy.md#boards-and-caching) composes

helper or assume its adapter behavior. Those dependencies are not installed here.

its finished relation; [its initializer](../../config/initializers/pagy.rb) sets
the page-size parameter and limits.

class NotesController < ApplicationController
  include Pagy::Backend

  before_action :set_note, only: [:show, :edit, :update, :destroy]
  before_action :set_notebooks, except: [:show, :destroy]

  def index
    @notes = current_user.notes.includes(:notebook).with_rich_text_body.newest_first

    if params[:notebook_id].present?
      @notebook = current_user.notebooks.find(params[:notebook_id])
      @notes = @notes.where(notebooks: @notebook)
    end

    @notes = @notes.where(status: params[:status]) if Note.statuses.key?(params[:status])
    @notes = @notes.titled_like(params[:query]) if params[:query].present?

    @pagy, @notes = pagy(@notes)
  end

  def new
    @note = Note.new
  end

  def create
    @note = Note.new(note_params)
    @note.notebook = owned_notebook

    if @note.save
      redirect_to notes_path, notice: "Note created."
    else
      render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def show
  end

  def edit
  end

  def update
    @note.assign_attributes(note_params)
    @note.notebook = owned_notebook

    if @note.save
      redirect_to notes_path, notice: "Note updated."
    else
      render :edit, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def destroy
    @note.destroy
    redirect_to notes_path, status: :see_other, notice: "Note deleted."
  end

  private
    def set_note
      @note = current_user.notes.find(params[:id])
    end

    def set_notebooks
      @notebooks = current_user.notebooks.order(:name, :id)
    end

    def note_params
      params.require(:note).permit(:title, :body, :status, :doi, :tag_list, :highlight_color)
    end

    def owned_notebook
      current_user.notebooks.find_by(id: params.dig(:note, :notebook_id))
    end
end
